Maya Partnerships: Quick sync0min. Goal: ship a compact reference-patterns repo + Terraform quickstarts for cloud partner onramps (marketplace artifacts + self-hosted). Need owners, QA checklist, and packaging path. Volunteers?
Ravi Cloud: I can lead marketplace packaging details. Aim for a light artifact bundle that maps to AMI/container + deploy script.
Jo Eng: I'll own terraform modules and CI. Planning scoped modules for compute/network/iam and lightweight terratest smoke.
Priya Arch: I'll do the reference diagrams (marketplace flow vs private deploy) and an ops runbook stub for Dedicated/Private.
Mark AWS-Bizdev: Ian align with partner PMs on marketplace constraints and sizing guidance (graviton vs x86 recommendations).
Jo Eng: Proposal for modules layout: modules/compute, modules/network, modules/iam, examples/quickstart-aws/gcp/azure. CI -> terraform fmt/validate + tflint + containerized terratest.
Maya Partnerships: Minimal QA checklist suggestion:
- module docs + example overlays per cloud
- license + third-party notice headers
- secret handling review + KMS notes
- marketplace packaging checklist
- sandbox e2e smoke deploy with healthcheck verification
Ravi Cloud: Marketplace checklist will include AMI/container tagging, size guidance, packaging manifest examples.
Jo Eng: Quickstart will ship base docker image + config flag for quantized artifacts (not including large model blobs). Lock terraform to 1.5.x and pin providers.
Priya Arch: For diagrams, I'll include a 1-page comparison: marketplace pull flow, private VPC path, and network/KMS callouts. Also add a small perf/cost table per pattern.
Maya Partnerships: Action items and deadlines:
- Jo: terraform modules + CI PR by 2024-10-04
- Priya: diagrams + ops runbook draft by 2024-09-30
- Ravi: marketplace packaging checklist by 2024-09-25
- Mark: sample app variants + brief README by 2024-10-01
Repo-bot: Repository initialized: redwood/onramp-ref-patterns by jo-eng
Mark AWS-Bizdev: I'll prepare 3 sample apps (hosted-api, dedicated-helm, onprem-compose) and add short READMEs.
Maya Partnerships: Let's run 2-week sync cadence until GA. Next checkin Tue 9am PT. If any partner legal/compliance items appear, tag @Legal-Review.
Legal-Review Bot: Acknowledged. Attach contracts or partner terms for review when available.
Maya Partnerships: Thanks everyone. Closing thread until next sync.
